결석하다.x: I caught a cold, so I missed school yesterday.
결석하다.t: Pronounced [결써카다]; the opposite is 출석하다 'to attend'.

후식.x: After the meal, we had fruit for dessert.
후식.t: 디저트 is just as common, especially for café sweets; restaurants often say 후식 for the after-meal treat.

비록.x: Even though we don't have money, we're happy.

입에 맞다.forms: N이/가 입에 맞아요 · 입에 안 맞아요 · 입에 맞으세요?
입에 맞다.m: to suit one's taste, to be to one's liking
입에 맞다.t: Hosts politely ask guests 입에 맞으세요? 'Is the food to your liking?'

대응.ex: 이번 사고에 대한 정부의 대응이 너무 늦었습니다.
대응.x: The government's response to this accident was too slow.

감각.ex: 그 친구는 패션 감각이 정말 좋아요.
감각.x: That friend has a really good sense of fashion.
감각.t: Collocations: 감각이 있다 'to have a flair', 감각이 없다 'to feel numb' or 'to lack taste'.

회장.m: chairman, president (of a company or group)
회장.x: The chairman came to the meeting in person today.
회장.t: Add 님 when addressing or referring to them politely: 회장님.

처방.ex: 의사의 처방이 있어야 이 약을 살 수 있어요.
처방.x: You need a doctor's prescription to buy this medicine.
처방.e: Literally 'a method for handling' the illness.
처방.t: In Korea you take the 처방전 from the clinic to a separate 약국.

규정.ex: 회사 규정에 따라 사무실에서는 담배를 피울 수 없어요.
규정.x: Under company rules, you can't smoke in the office.
규정.e: Literally 'a rule that has been fixed.'

분석.ex: 전문가들의 분석에 따르면 물가가 더 오를 겁니다.
분석.x: According to experts' analysis, prices will rise further.

마땅하다.x: There's no good place to eat lunch.
마땅하다.e: Often negative: 마땅한 게 없다 means 'nothing quite suitable'.

와-과 달리.forms: 과 달리 after a consonant (예상과 달리) · 와 달리 after a vowel (어제와 달리)
와-과 달리.x: Unlike yesterday, the weather is clear today.
와-과 달리.t: 예상과 달리 'contrary to expectations' is a common set phrase. In conversation 하고 달리 or (이)랑 달리 also work.

재택근무.ex: 저는 일주일에 두 번 재택근무를 해요.
재택근무.x: I work from home twice a week.
재택근무.t: Pronounced [재택끈무] — the ㄱ is tensed after ㄱ.

배송비.ex: 삼만 원 이상 사면 배송비가 무료예요.
배송비.x: Shipping is free if you spend 30,000 won or more.
배송비.e: -비 = cost or fee: 배송비, 교통비, 생활비.
배송비.t: 무료 배송 = free shipping; 배송 is for parcels, while 배달 is used for food delivery.

소방차.ex: 소방차 여러 대가 불이 난 건물 앞에 모였어요.
소방차.x: Several fire trucks gathered in front of the burning building.

면역.ex: 한 번 걸린 병에는 면역이 생기기도 해요.
면역.x: You sometimes become immune to a disease you've had once.

혈당.ex: 단 음식을 먹으면 혈당이 빨리 올라가요.
혈당.x: Eating sweet food makes your blood sugar rise quickly.

소장.x: This painting is in the collection of the National Museum of Korea.
소장.t: Homonym warning: 소장 (所長) also means 'head of an office or institute'.
rel: to own, to have in one's collection

매립.x: We are running out of places to bury trash.

열중하다.m: to be absorbed in, to be engrossed in, to concentrate on
열중하다.ex: 아이들이 게임에 열중해서 부르는 소리도 못 들었어요.
열중하다.x: The kids were so into the game that they didn't even hear us call.
열중하다.e: Literally 'heat inside' — so into something you're fired up.
열중하다.t: Pronounced [열쭝하다] — the ㅈ is tensed after ㄹ.

월등하다.x: That team's skills were far superior.
월등하다.t: Pronounced [월뜽하다]; often 월등히 + 높다, 뛰어나다, 앞서다.

선견지명.ex: 그는 선견지명이 있어서 미리 집을 샀어요.
선견지명.x: He had foresight, so he bought a house ahead of time.

무궁무진하다.x: The potential of AI technology is truly limitless.

입이 닳도록.forms: 입이 닳도록 말하다 · 입이 닳도록 칭찬했어요
입이 닳도록.m: over and over; until one is blue in the face
입이 닳도록.ex: 엄마가 입이 닳도록 말했는데도 동생은 방을 안 치웠어요.
입이 닳도록.x: Mom told him until she was blue in the face, but my brother still didn't clean his room.
입이 닳도록.e: Literally 'until one's mouth wears out,' from 닳다 'to wear down.'
입이 닳도록.t: Pronounced [이비 달토록]; usually before 말하다, 칭찬하다 or 강조하다.

꼬투리를 잡다.forms: 꼬투리를 잡아요 · 꼬투리를 잡았어요 · 말꼬투리를 잡다
꼬투리를 잡다.m: to nitpick; to seize on a small slip to criticize
꼬투리를 잡다.ex: 그는 내 말의 꼬투리를 잡아서 계속 따졌어요.
꼬투리를 잡다.x: He seized on something I said and kept arguing.
꼬투리를 잡다.e: 꼬투리 = a seed pod, and also a small pretext or excuse to pick at.
꼬투리를 잡다.t: 말꼬투리를 잡다 = to pounce on a slip of the tongue.

실용주의.ex: 그 정부는 실용주의 외교 정책을 내세웠습니다.
실용주의.x: That government put forward a pragmatic foreign policy.

교직.x: My father was in the teaching profession for 30 years.
교직.t: Common patterns: 교직에 있다 'to be a teacher' and 교직을 떠나다 'to leave teaching'.

규합하다.m: to rally, to bring together (people, forces)
규합하다.ex: 그는 뜻이 같은 사람들을 규합해서 단체를 만들었어요.
규합하다.x: He brought together like-minded people and formed an organization.
규합하다.t: The object is usually people or groups: 세력을 규합하다, 동지를 규합하다.

질책하다.m: to rebuke, to scold, to reproach
질책하다.x: The department head harshly rebuked the employee who made the mistake.

반격.x: Our team's counterattack began in the second half.

사전 녹화.ex: 사전 녹화 보러 새벽부터 방송국에 갔어요.
사전 녹화.x: I went to the TV station at dawn to watch the pre-recording.
사전 녹화.e: 사전 'in advance' (literally 'before the matter') + 녹화 'video recording'.
사전 녹화.t: Fan club members can often get in to watch a music show's 사전 녹화, which may start very early in the morning. 녹화 is pronounced [노콰].

개천에서 용 난다.forms: 개천에서 용 났다더니 · 개천에서 용 난다고 하잖아요
개천에서 용 난다.m: a great person can rise from humble origins (lit. a dragon comes out of a small stream)
개천에서 용 난다.ex: 개천에서 용 났다더니, 산골 마을 출신 친구가 판사가 됐어요.
개천에서 용 난다.x: A dragon rose from a humble stream, as they say: a friend from a mountain village became a judge.
개천에서 용 난다.e: Literally 'a dragon rises out of a small stream (개천)': greatness emerging from the humblest place.
개천에서 용 난다.t: Usually said in the past tense: 개천에서 용 났다. It also comes up in debates about social mobility: 요즘은 개천에서 용 나기 어렵다 'it's hard to rise from nothing these days.'

위증.x: He was indicted on charges of committing perjury in court.
위증.t: The verb is 위증하다; the crime itself is 위증죄.

초상권.m: right of publicity, right to one's own image
초상권.ex: 허락 없이 사진을 올리면 초상권 침해가 될 수 있어요.
초상권.x: Posting someone's photo without permission can violate their image rights.
초상권.t: Pronounced [초상꿘]; collocation: 초상권을 침해하다 'to violate image rights'.

시정.x: The government ordered that the improper practices be corrected.
시정.t: Homonym alert: 시정 (市政) also means city administration, as in 시정 활동.

천착하다.m: to delve into, to dig deeply into (a subject)
천착하다.ex: 그 작가는 평생 인간의 고독에 천착했습니다.
천착하다.x: The writer delved into human loneliness all his life.
천착하다.e: Literally 'pierce and chisel' — boring deep into a subject.

조망하다.m: to view (a landscape) from above; to survey (a field)
조망하다.ex: 이 책은 한국 현대사를 폭넓게 조망합니다.
조망하다.x: This book offers a broad survey of modern Korean history.
조망하다.t: Real estate ads boast 한강 조망 'Han River view'.

간곡하다.x: He asked for help in an earnest voice.
간곡하다.e: Literally 'earnest and thorough' — pleading with full sincerity.
간곡하다.t: Almost always with requests: 간곡히 부탁드립니다 'I earnestly ask you'. Pronounced [간고카다].

운집하다.m: to gather in great numbers, to throng, to flock
운집하다.x: Tens of thousands of citizens thronged the plaza.
운집하다.e: Literally 'gather like clouds' — people massing thickly together.

도식.x: They showed the complicated process in a simple diagram.

아연실색.x: Everyone in the meeting room went pale and speechless at the unexpected news.
아연실색.e: Literally 'struck dumb and losing one's color'.
